name: CA ANZ Achiever Program
provider: Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand
summary: Paid accounting internships for penultimate and final-year accounting students, arranged through Chartered Accountants ANZ.
key: All internships offered through the Achiever Program are paid, with pay varying by employer.
who: Penultimate or final-year tertiary accounting student in Australia or New Zealand
how: Complete the online application form when the intake opens.
Eligible applicants are invited to a video interview, then shortlisted students interview with an employer.
catches: Applications only open during intake periods.

source.label: CA ANZ: Achiever Program for students

evidence.quote: All internships offered through the Achiever Program are paid, with compensation varying by employer.
You must be a penultimate or final-year tertiary accounting student in Australia or New Zealand.
